recPick.title: A lighter 8K/4K gimbal camera made for today’s vertical video creators
recPick.body: Insta360 just dropped the Luna Pro, a trimmed-down take on the Ultra that delivers an 8K/30 and 4K/120 handheld gimbal with a Leica Summicron lens and 1" sensor—while still capturing true vertical 4K, it’s tailored for Reels, Shorts, and TikToks in a way the Ultra wasn’t ([gearpatrol.com](https://www.gearpatrol.com/briefings/product-news/?utm_source=openai)). The lighter build means you can start shooting right now without lugging a full rig around. The trade‑off? You lose one lens compared to the Ultra, so your framing is less flexible and you’ll want to pick your shots more deliberately.
